installs: Thirty-two skill directories under skills/, each holding one SKILL.md with 167 accompanying reference documents (Markdown guides and C# snippets) across the bundle. The README installs the whole pack with npx skills add Unity-Technologies/skills and names Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Cline as compatible hosts; the further 50-plus agents behind the skills.sh link are a format compatibility list rather than a documented install and are not recorded.
distribution_machinery: scripts/check-skill-frontmatter.mjs with .github/workflows/validate-skills.yml, which validate SKILL.md frontmatter in CI; neither ships into a host.
not_a_system: Owns no state it reads back and does no enforced work: the skills are documents the host reads to perform Unity operations, the C# files are reference snippets rather than executed programs, and the only shipped code validates frontmatter during continuous integration.
license_note: LICENSE.md places the material under the Unity Companion License for Unity-dependent projects (see https://unity3d.com/legal/licenses/unity_companion_license): custom proprietary terms, not an open-source licence, and none is inferred beyond the file.

license_evidence.scope: Entire repository under the Unity Companion License for Unity-dependent projects (LICENSE.md)
